Nick (Sales): FYI — Ava from Solaro wants a POC for a custom model 'nomad-70b-quant' for doc summarization. They need catalog compatibility, security sign-off, and ballpark pricing. Target: 30-50 rps, ~200–250ms SLO. Need answers by Fri EOD.
Maria (SE): Can you share the model artifact (HF/ggml/S3 link) and tokenizer? Also avg prompt/response lengths and whether long-context (>= 8k) is required. KV cache and quantization profile matters.
Ava (Customer POC): We'll upload model to S3 tonight: s3://solaro/nomad-70b/int8.tar.gz. Typical prompt ~120 tokens, response ~260 tokens. Peak batch size 4. Data contains de-identified PHI (we can provide redaction notes). We need KMS + audit logs.
Oliver (Infra): Nomad-70b-int8 will likely need an 80GB A100/H100 class node for good latency with 4 concurrent streams. If you keep seq <= 2048 we can hit ~200–300ms tail. KV cache OK at default but if they later expand to 8k we'd need different kernel selection. Recommend int8 kernels + prefix KV caching. For low-latency tails we should have a fallback variant (nomad-13b-int8).
Maria (SE): If Ava can accept a fallback to nomad-13b-int8 for sub-150ms tails, we can implement smart routing (latency-based fallback) and keep quality baseline. I need tokenizer to validate BPE offsets.
Sophie (Security): Since there's PHI, this can't live on public hosted unless redacted and contractually allowed. Options: Dedicated with customer VPC or Private deployment. Requirements: KMS/HSM integration, audit log retention (1y), SOC2 + encryption at rest/in-transit. We'll need the completed security questionnaire before POC.
Raj (Legal): We can provide DPA. For PHI we may need a BAA; I'll flag procurement. Please send the customer's legal contact.
Fiona (PM): Proposed rollout: 1) receive artifacts + tokenizer, 2) SE perf run on staging, 3) security questionnaire & DPA, 4) reserve capacity (Dedicated burst) for POC, 5) canary routing for 48h. Can we sync tomorrow for 1 hour?
Maria (SE): I'll run an initial perf once we have the model files. Sample staging run command (infra):
```
# add model & perf test
redwoodctl model add --name nomad-70b-int8 --repo s3://solaro/nomad-70b/int8 --quant int8
redwoodctl perf --model nomad-70b-int8 --batch 4 --seq 2048 --duration 120s
```
Oliver (Infra): Creating infra ticket and reserving burst pool. INFRA-4821 created: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-4821 (will attach perf results and node sizing).
deploy-bot: Ticket INFRA-4821 assigned to Oliver (Infra).
Nick (Sales): Pricing ballpark for POC: hosted int8 nomad-70b ~ $1.2 per 1k tokens (estimate); with Dedicated/reserved commits we can target ~$0.6 per 1k tokens for the POC run. Final quote after perf numbers.
Ava (Customer POC): Thanks — we'll provide model URL, tokenizer, and the signed security questionnaire by EOD. 10am PT tomorrow works for the sync.
Maria (SE): Checklist added to thread: artifacts, tokenizer, perf-run results, security questionnaire, DPA/BAA, reserved capacity, fallback variant, canary plan.
Nick (Sales): 👍 I'll send calendar invite and loop account exec. Next steps: Maria to perf, Oliver to reserve nodes, Sophie to review questionnaire, Raj to prep DPA.
